use_case: Demand forecasting and automated reordering: weekly SKU forecasts, suggested purchase orders, and automatic release of replenishment purchase orders to OEM and authorized sources up to $250,000
vendor_or_model: Forecasting platform vendor (machine learning time-series models trained per customer on company data)
data_categories: 3 years of order history including DoD orders (FCI); inventory; supplier lead times and prices; approved supplier list
affects_individuals: No (indirectly affects service levels for reseller businesses)
human_in_the_loop: Auto-release only for authorized sources within limits; buyers review all other suggestions and any line over $250,000 or more than 20% above forecast
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21 (FCI safeguarding schedule in the vendor contract); FAR 52.204-25 and DFARS 252.246-7008 (sourcing rules apply to auto-released orders); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
bias_testing_status: Segment fill-rate and forecast bias review (gap found; section 7)
monitoring: Weekly WAPE by category; monthly fill rate by customer segment; drift alerts (to be built, POAM-021)

use_case: Quote and price recommendations for sales representatives (suggested discount within approved price bands)
vendor_or_model: ERP pricing optimization module (vendor machine learning)
data_categories: Quote history, contract pricing, win/loss data (Confidential)
human_in_the_loop: Sales representative chooses the price; recommendations stay inside approved price bands; customer-facing chat for pricing not enabled (R-063)
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5; reseller contract confidentiality
bias_testing_status: Price dispersion by reseller size reviewed quarterly

use_case: Reseller trade credit limit recommendations (new accounts and periodic reviews)
vendor_or_model: Commercial credit scoring vendor model plus company payment history features
data_categories: Business credit bureau data, payment history, financial statements; owner information for sole proprietor resellers
human_in_the_loop: Credit analyst approves every new limit, decrease, or denial; model is one input
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B for trade credit (12 CFR 1002.9(a)(3)(ii) notice and reasons on request; 1002.9(b)(2) specific reasons); Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01 if a consequential lending decision (counsel reviewing)
protected_characteristic_inputs: No direct inputs; ZIP code and years in business reviewed as possible proxies
bias_testing_status: Outcome comparison by business size, region, and years in business (2026-05); reason-code mapping incomplete
monitoring: Quarterly approval and decrease rates by segment; reason request log

use_case: Applicant resume screening and ranking for warehouse, services, and inside sales requisitions
vendor_or_model: Applicant tracking system vendor ranking feature
build_or_buy: Buy (feature in the applicant tracking SaaS)
data_categories: Resumes and application answers of applicants
human_in_the_loop: Recruiter reviews every applicant shown as qualified; ranking may not auto-reject; suspended for California requisitions since 2026-09-01
applicable_laws: CCPA ADMT rules for California applicants (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, 7200 et seq., existing uses by 2027-01-01) and risk assessment (7150 et seq.); Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01 for Colorado applicants; Title VII disparate impact (29 CFR 1607.4(D) four-fifths rule as a screening threshold)
protected_characteristic_inputs: Not as model inputs; resume content can carry proxies (names, graduation years, gaps)
bias_testing_status: Vendor adverse impact report only; company selection-rate analysis due 2026-11-30 (POAM-021)
monitoring: Monthly selection rates by sex and race or ethnicity from voluntary self-identification; recruiter override rate

use_case: Receiving image inspection that flags counterfeit indicators on packaging and labels
vendor_or_model: Computer vision model built by the data science team on the cloud ML service
data_categories: Images of packaging, labels, and serial plates
human_in_the_loop: Model may only add inspections, never remove them; lab technicians decide
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.246-7008 and FAR 52.204-25 (does not replace required authentication)
bias_testing_status: Not applicable (no individuals); performance tested against known counterfeits
monitoring: Parallel testing against lab findings; missed suspect lots (R-065)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for drafting, summarizing, and analysis

use_case: Reseller-facing support assistant on the platform (order status, returns, product availability)

build_or_buy: Build on a cloud AI service

applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (accurate statements); Texas TRAIGA prohibitions reviewed (none triggered)

use_case: Contract clause extraction for federal flowdowns (identifies FAR and DFARS clauses in purchase orders)
vendor_or_model: Generative AI service in the commercial tenant
build_or_buy: Build on a cloud AI service
data_categories: Federal purchase orders and subcontracts (FCI); CUI prohibited
human_in_the_loop: Contracts staff confirm every extracted clause before it is applied
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21 (FCI in an approved tenant); DFARS 252.204-7012 (CUI must never be processed outside the FSCE)

use_case: Warehouse labor scheduling and productivity scoring
vendor_or_model: Labor management system vendor AI module
data_categories: Scan events, task times, attendance of distribution staff and agency workers
human_in_the_loop: Supervisors set schedules; scores used for coaching only, not discipline, until review
applicable_laws: Employment discrimination laws; CCPA ADMT rules if used for significant decisions about California workers (no California distribution center; counsel confirms); Colorado SB26-189 (no Colorado distribution center)
